name: arena-league
description: Phase 9 B4 (open-core part): the Neutral Ground table runner as a HARNESS. Seats up to seven peers behind the `Peer` interface on a diplomacy_standard table (house diplomats on every unseated power), drives them through the same wire frames and edge validation as the CLI, records every peer's inputs, meters cost per game with a hard stop and a monthly cap accumulator, and builds verifiable reports and per-model evidence. It runs NO inference and imports no network module: the provider connectors that implement `Peer` live Sixi-side (docs/phase-9/NEUTRAL-GROUND.md).
